title: Circles are like Ellipses, or Ellipses are like Circles? Measuring the Degree of Asymmetry of Static and Contextual Word Embeddings and the Implications to Representation Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring the geometric properties (asymmetry) of word embeddings using psychoanalysis-derived datasets. Its scope is technical and confined to computational linguistics and representation learning, with no component dedicated to evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
